requirements.requirement: Enable a persistent host firewall on node1 (firewalld active, enabled at boot, survives reboot)
requirements.summary: Baseline showed firewalld already active/enabled (cmd-8472432e8205433b). Executor confirmed enablement (cmd-0a12224ac05f40e7) and, critically, demonstrated persistence across an actual reboot: boot_id changed from bf4e9cbb...to a6aa9681... (cmd-fd337058b4e54d3b, cross-checked by global boot-identity observations), and post-restart firewalld was active/enabled with identical permanent+runtime public zone rules (cmd-e3f9672e54a7495d).
ssh service retained/confirmed in public zone permanent and runtime config both before and after reload, and again after reboot; sshd active throughout.
8080/tcp added permanently, present in runtime+permanent zone listing, and functionally verified reachable (HTTP 200) both before and after reboot.

requirements.requirement: Reject unrelated inbound connections (all other ports/services)
requirements.summary: cockpit and dhcpv6-client services removed from the public zone; runtime/permanent zone now lists only ssh service and 8080/tcp port. Functional test to an unrelated port (9090) failed/timed out, and nft ruleset shows reject-with-icmpx-admin-prohibited for undefined traffic, consistent before and after reboot.

requirements.requirement: Provider-wide node-restart evidence protocol executed on node1 with pre/post boot identity, acknowledgement, and recovered state
requirements.summary: Pre-restart boot_id/firewall/ssh baseline captured (cmd-97fa9365973e4c22), reboot acknowledged before disconnect (cmd-4f765f0b1eea443a), unreachable window observed (cmd-88ae97bcf1194758, cmd-c57afe4d13c442bd), new boot_id confirmed (cmd-fd337058b4e54d3b), and post-restart recovery of firewalld, sshd, zone config, and functional 8080/9090 behavior confirmed (cmd-e3f9672e54a7495d). Cross-checked against fixed global boot-identity snapshots.

overall_summary: All material outcomes of the task were satisfied: node1 now has a persistent firewalld configuration in the public zone allowing only SSH and TCP 8080, with cockpit/dhcpv6-client removed so unrelated inbound traffic is rejected via icmpx admin-prohibited. This was verified functionally (8080 reachable, 9090 refused) both before and after a real reboot (boot_id bf4e9cbb...→a6aa9681...), which also satisfies the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol for this single-node topology. Minor hygiene ding for leftover test listener log/pid files in /tmp.
limitations: Functional reachability tests were performed from the node itself against its own NODE_IP rather than from an independent external client, so true external-network reachability/blocking was not directly observed, only inferred from local socket/zone state and nft ruleset inspection.
Small residue of ephemeral test files (/tmp/http8080*.log/.pid) left in /tmp is unlikely to affect functionality but was not cleaned up.

operational_hygiene.summary: All state-changing commands were tied to the task or its verification: firewall rule changes and firewalld enable (cmd-0a12224ac05f40e7) directly implement the requirement; the reboot (cmd-4f765f0b1eea443a) is required by the mandatory restart protocol and doubles as persistence proof for this specific task. The two ephemeral python http.server test listeners (cmd-fc079fcb771d4003 pre-restart, cmd-e3f9672e54a7495d post-restart) were bounded, low-risk functional checks and were killed at the end of each command, but their log/pid files (/tmp/http8080.log, /tmp/http8080.pid, /tmp/http8080_post.log, /tmp/http8080_post.pid) were left behind as minor residue visible in the after_executor temp-files diff. No failed services, no destructive or broad mutations, no weakened security controls, and package health remained clean before and after.
